season.title: YouTube thumbnails for the season
season.intro: All thumbnails for the games on game days your club hosts in a season, at once. Away games of your teams are not included; the host club gets those. You get the livestream image showing the pairing for setting up the streams, and the highlights image with the final score for videos edited days later. This keeps working after the game day's overlay access has expired.
season.failed: The season's games could not be loaded.
season.empty: Your club does not host a game day in this season.
season.summary: {{gameDays}} game days with {{games}} games, {{ended}} of them with a final score.
season.livestreamHint: Livestream thumbnails of all games as a ZIP, one folder per game day, 1280 × 720 pixels
season.highlightsHint: Highlights thumbnails with the final score of all finished games as a ZIP, one folder per game day
season.noHighlights: Highlights images become available once a game has ended.

page.title: YouTube thumbnails
page.intro: Images of 1280 × 720 pixels, ready to upload to YouTube: the livestream image with the pairing and, after the final whistle, the highlights image with the final score. They carry the competition's mark and colours, matching the overlays.
page.noToken: This page needs the game day's overlay access. Open it with "Thumbnails öffnen" (open thumbnails) in the control panel.
page.expired: This access is invalid or has expired.
page.seasonHint: Club and team managers of the host club get thumbnails for past game days on the "Match secretariat" page, as a batch for the whole season.
page.failed: The games could not be loaded. Please reload the page.
page.noGames: No games have been set up for this game day.
page.livestreamHint: Livestream thumbnail of this game as a PNG
page.highlightsHint: Highlights thumbnail with the final score as a PNG
page.allLivestreamHint: Livestream thumbnails of all games of this game day as a ZIP
page.allHighlightsHint: Highlights thumbnails of all finished games as a ZIP
page.highlightPending: Highlights image after the final whistle
